Bakeoff qualitative review

Cutoff 2024-12-03 · H=28 · reuses reports/forecasts_*.csv (no retrain).

Manual checklist

  • ☐ Promo spikes: LightGBM tracks; univariate miss or smear
  • ☐ Mean step: SN stays wrong after break; ETS/LGBM adapt better
  • ☐ Intermittent: Chronos vs SN on zeros/spikes (see table)
  • ☐ Cold start: short history visible; who over/under-reacts
  • ☐ Horizon: who degrades after h≈14
